notes: Added after the first results because all-or-nothing over about 187 questions saturates at 0 for every lane. One deterministic OK-versus-dispute rule, no tuned threshold. Scored from recorded answers on the frozen 100. No new model call.

Gold disputed amount is max(0, printed patient responsibility - correct patient responsibility) on a gold-dispute line. Caught dollars are that amount where the model verdict is also dispute. False-alarm dollars are the printed patient responsibility where the model disputes a gold-OK line. No threshold.
Primary rows are the frozen 100 (ladder_hard_ids.json) except DeepSeek, whose run file stopped early and is marked partial.

The OK-versus-dispute files were added after the first results. line_all_checks is the earlier all-six line score from hard_test_*_line_verdict.json on the same 100, where that file exists. Cheaper models have no recorded all-six file, so that metric is empty. strict_case stays beside both. The 300-case question-accuracy slice is a different denominator.
Drex $/1,000 is the stored Drex token cost in ladder_summary.json ($0.03 per million input tokens). It is not a fresh Nace invoice.
Latency is the median of recorded per-case latency_ms on the cited run. Drex answer logs repeat that call latency on each question; one copy is kept.

Where ladder_summary.json has a list $/1,000 for that model, that recorded figure is used. Hybrid and the BillProof system use the mean of recorded list_cost_usd, or cost_usd when list_cost_usd is absent.

Qwen and DeepSeek lanes are recorded DeepInfra answers on the longest prefix of the frozen order where Drex also has an answer. drex_then_* keeps Drex when recorded confidence is at least 0.90 and otherwise uses that model's recorded answer. t=0.90 was not tuned: these rows are the reported set, and no DeepInfra run exists on a separate dev or practice split. partial means the prefix is short of the frozen n. Combo $/1,000 is Drex's recorded cost plus the recorded DeepInfra cost scaled to the routed share of the packed call.

Otherwise it is the recorded packed call, scaled as (list input dollars + list output dollars * routed/asked) * (recorded cost_usd / list-price of that call) when cost_basis is provider_estimated_cost and both the recorded cost and the list price are positive. List rates are DeepInfra's published cents_per_token figures from _deepinfra_list. If the provider did not send estimated_cost, the scale is 1 and the list rate is used. If no list rate is known, the recorded cost_usd is scaled by routed/asked. The escalation model alone uses mean(recorded cost_usd) * 1000 and no Drex cost. Drex alone uses mean(recorded Drex cost_usd) * 1000 and no DeepInfra cost. On prior auth, a case with any routed question takes the escalation model's recorded decision and the other case-level parts; Drex keeps those when nothing is routed.
formulas.latency_p50_ms: p50 latency is the median over paired cases of [Drex recorded latency_ms + DeepInfra recorded latency_ms * routed/asked when any question is routed]. Drex alone is the median Drex latency. The escalation model alone is the median of its recorded latency.

formulas.rule: Drex keeps every question with recorded confidence >= threshold. The rest take GPT-6.1 Sol's recorded answer to the same question.
formulas.cost_per_1000_usd: mean over cases of [Drex recorded cost_usd + (if any question routed) (GPT recorded input_tokens * $2 + GPT recorded output_tokens * routed/asked * $10) / 1e6] * 1000. GPT list price $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens.

threshold_selection.note: t=0.90 was not tuned. Persius rows are the frozen 400 test, Hard rows are the frozen 100, and the 370 prior-auth rows are the shared held-out set this bench reports. No DeepInfra answers exist on a separate dev or practice split. formulas.rule: Drex keeps every question with recorded confidence >= 0.90. The rest take this model's recorded answer to the same question.
formulas.cases: Only cases in the longest prefix of the frozen order where both Drex and this model have a non-error recorded answer. partial is true when that prefix is shorter than the frozen set.
formulas.cost_per_1000_usd: cost per 1,000 cases = mean(Drex recorded cost_usd + routed DeepInfra cost) * 1000. Routed cost is 0 when no question is sent. Otherwise it is the recorded packed call, scaled as (list input dollars + list output dollars * routed/asked) * (recorded cost_usd / list-price of that call) when cost_basis is provider_estimated_cost and both the recorded cost and the list price are positive. List rates are DeepInfra's published cents_per_token figures from _deepinfra_list. If the provider did not send estimated_cost, the scale is 1 and the list rate is used. If no list rate is known, the recorded cost_usd is scaled by routed/asked. The escalation model alone uses mean(recorded cost_usd) * 1000 and no Drex cost. Drex alone uses mean(recorded Drex cost_usd) * 1000 and no DeepInfra cost. On prior auth, a case with any routed question takes the escalation model's recorded decision and the other case-level parts; Drex keeps those when nothing is routed.
formulas.latency_p50_ms: p50 latency is the median over paired cases of [Drex recorded latency_ms + DeepInfra recorded latency_ms * routed/asked when any question is routed]. Drex alone is the median Drex latency. The escalation model alone is the median of its recorded latency.
